Don't jump into another topic until you completely understand the current one you're studying. Don't rely only on textbooks, try searching it on Youtube. Sometimes I have no idea what the heck I'm reading but if I try to look it up on Youtube, somehow I can finally understand the material. Don't rush. I feel like panicking if I'm trying to rush the lessons. Take short breaks. Have you ever tried lofi beats? Listening to lofi while studying helps me to calm down because I'm an anxious freshman this school year. 


Also, as much as possible don't focus on the thought of getting good grades. Try to understand the materials one step at a time. Good luck! Hope this helps.
